question.text: Which of the following is a NON-MANDATORY document that mutual fund schemes may provide to investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: The monthly fund factsheet is a voluntary market-practice disclosure published by AMCs. It is not a regulatory requirement, unlike the SID, SAI, and KIM, which are mandatory scheme-related documents. The Trap: SID, SAI, and KIM are all mandatory disclosures prescribed by SEBI regulations. Candidates sometimes assume Fact Sheets are mandatory because they are so widely used. Note: Identify Fact Sheet as the non-mandatory item and the SID/SAI/KIM trio as the mandatory scheme-related documents.
